Package gov.noaa.ncei.geosamples.api.service.sample

Class SampleDto

  • java.lang.Object
    • gov.noaa.ncei.geosamples.api.service.sample.SampleDto
  • public class SampleDto
extends Object
    This class is needed because the CuratorsSampleTsqpEntity contains a shape which prevents the "distinct" SQL query. Also when doing a "distinct" query, sorting becomes an issue when the columns being sorted are in a join table. The nature of the queries makes using the "distinct" keyword unavoidable.
